title: Building blocks
description: The catalogue a journey's steps point into when they say what they use: the tools, systems, standards and trust networks of the demonstrator, each in one architecture layer, each linked to the ArchiMate components that deploy it where there are any. A step's `uses` edge (user-scenario schema) names a block here, with the role that block plays in that step.

question.description: The question the layer answers for a policy audience.

short.description: A label for a crowded grid.

kind.description: tool: software anyone can deploy (OHS FHIR SDK). system: a country's deployed system (the Onesan national FHIR server). standard: a specification (IPS, IHE VHL). network: a trust network (WHO GDHCN).

jurisdiction.description: Whose block it is. A country's deployed system belongs to that country; tools, standards and trust networks anyone can adopt are International. The ArchiMate views split the RA by jurisdiction on this field.

what.description: What it is, in one sentence.

soWhat.description: Why it matters for the journeys, in one sentence.

components.description: The ArchiMate elements of the overlay (tools/archimate/overlay.py) that deploy this block, by element key. Omitted when the block is not drawn as a component (most standards).

links.description: Where to read more: the specification, the source, the IG page.
